label: Round cast manhole
description: Flush cast-iron cover with waffle studs, pick slots and raised rim in an iron seat and round concrete collar.

label: Open manhole with guard
description: Open square chamber with steel edge angle, ladder extension stiles, tread-plate lid laid aside and a red/pale four-sided folding guard on rubber feet.

label: Fingerpost
description: Cast-base fingerpost with three pointed blades at different heights and bearings, raised abstract lettering, clamp collars and ball finial.

label: Roadside direction panel
description: Advance direction panel on twin posts and concrete footings: rear mounting channels, bordered face with arrow, stacked destination bars and route patch; 1.6 clearance under the panel.

label: W-beam guardrail
description: Six-metre W-section rail on I-posts with timber blockouts and splice bolts; both ends flare back to rounded buffer terminals. Traffic face +Z.

label: Wire-rope barrier
description: Four tensioned ropes on slim posts in socket collars, middle pair weaving between posts, reflector caps, ropes descending through turnbuckles to concrete end anchors.

label: Sheffield stands
description: Three rounded inverted-U stands with base plates and two parked diamond-frame bicycles (spoked wheels, chainset, saddle, bars).

label: Wheel-slot rack
description: Staggered high/low hoops welded to twin base rails with end feet; two bicycles slotted front-wheel first.

label: Single-cab pickup
description: Two-door pickup facing -Z: bonnet and barred grille, glazed cab, ribbed open bed with wheel tubs, tailgate, step bumper and headache rack.

label: Crew-cab pickup with canopy
description: Four-door pickup facing -Z with longer wheelbase, glazed bed canopy with side and rear windows, and cab roof bars.

label: Glazed bus shelter
description: Steel-framed shelter open to +Z: transparent back and end panes in one separate static glass batch, unlit advert case, cantilever roof with fascia and rear gutter, perch bench, timetable case and pictogram stop flag.

label: Timber lean-to bus shelter
description: Boarded timber lean-to on pad stones, open to +Z, rafters under a corrugated sheet roof, plank bench on stone blocks, request-stop plate post with timetable case and litter bin.

label: Pad-mounted transformer
description: Cabinet on chamfered plinth with double doors, four pitched-slat louvres plus side vent, hinges, hasp, warning triangle, lifting eyes and rear cable ducts rising from grade.

label: Fenced transformer compound
description: Ground-mounted tank transformer on a pad with finned radiator banks, conservator, porcelain bushings and LV cable box inside a palisade fence with double gate and warning sign.

label: Timber crossarm pole
description: Tapered timber pole with braced crossarm, three porcelain pin insulators, step bolts, number plate and a stay wire with insulator, guard sleeve and anchor.

label: Concrete service pole
description: Octagonal tapered concrete pole with base collar, spool rack, service cable drip loop into a conduit weatherhead, base junction box and an unlit outreach lantern arm.

label: Three-phase line span
description: Single 12.7 m terminal span: three sagging conductors between strain insulator strings on two braced timber poles, back-stay guys and bird diverters.

label: Service drop
description: Twisted duplex drop sagging from a timber pole spool rack to a service mast with weatherhead and drip loop, mounted on a meter pillar with glazed meter window.

label: Pipe outfall headwall
description: Concrete headwall with splayed wing walls, coping, weep holes and handrail; projecting pipe mouth with dark bore and hinged flap valve; apron, end sill and fixed irregular rip-rap pockets with exposed ground and a clear central discharge. Discharges toward +Z.

label: Twin box culvert with screen
description: Twin-cell box culvert with parapet, straight tapered wing walls, baffle-block apron and an inclined bar trash screen with lifting eyes; parapet handrail. Discharges toward +Z.
